adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` call is wrapped in `try/catch`, but the `catch (err)` block only logs a static string (`console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")`) and does not log or otherwise surface `err`. This makes email delivery failures hard to diagnose in production and is a concrete, diff-grounded observability/maintainability issue rather than a direct functional defect (the handler continues and returns success regardless).
